title: The first commissioned IAM chain
lead: One sample goes in. Five instruments read it, and every one of them passed a test that was written and sealed before its data was seen.

One of them needs no outside reference at all: it reads a person's cells against themselves. The atlas behind them was fitted the way cosmologists fit a map of the sky, and on the jobs an atlas is used for, it beat both published references in the field.
These are research instruments, not a diagnostic test. Where the lines on the gauge belong for cancer is for cancer researchers to find; these are the instruments to find it with.
